transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. As part of our routine quarter-end property reconciliation, I need to conduct a line-by-line check-in with each of your sections before I sign off on the disposition order. We'll be covering the unserviceable battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables. The available disposition categories are quarantine, reissue, repair, and calibration return. I'd like to start by hearing from each section on the status of your tagged items. Who's ready to begin?
